reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm survives the evidence test. Although some symbols share letters or lengths, there is no stable substitution frame where recurring parts make consistent meaning contributions and whole meanings are predictable from those parts. For example, the two-letter symptom codes (AC, DE, ES, etc.) do not show reusable segments with consistent semantics; the lowercase and uppercase single-symbol entries are mostly standalone lexical items; and forms like bk, fr, bt, Fc, hot, and ok are not compositionally recoverable from smaller attested parts in a shared productive frame. Because false morphology is worse than a flat lexicon, all supplied symbols are treated as opaque lexical symbols.
